full_prompt_en: A square tempera-like painting presents a pale round building in the middle of a crowded old city square beneath a dark sky. The building has a low conical roof colored in warm terracotta, with a narrow white shaft of light rising vertically from its apex into the nearly black upper field. Beneath the roof, a continuous ring of small dark arches circles the upper level. The lower wall is cream with broad shallow arches; a small central doorway opens as a black rectangle under a decorated semicircular panel. Taller brown stone buildings stand close on both sides, their stacked windows and dark openings making the round structure look brighter and more self-contained. Groups of robed people gather at its left and right walls. On the left, the crowd curves inward from the edge, with several pale cloaks among deeper brown garments. On the right, another cluster stands close together between the building and the adjacent tower. A few individuals are separated at the front, leaving an open pale forecourt that leads to the central doorway. Their small faces and garments are rendered with controlled but simplified detail; no one person dominates the scene. Warm earth pigments, gray-brown stone, and muted cream establish the architecture, while the upper sky is a broad charcoal field. The unusual white light supplies the strongest value contrast, and softer ambient light brightens the front wall and ground without pronounced cast shadows. The matte surface shows fine grain and a slightly worn, fresco-like finish. The overall composition is solemn and strongly centered, using symmetrical architectural masses and gathered human rhythms to focus attention on the luminous roof.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形蛋彩般绘画在深色天空下的旧城广场中央呈现一座浅色圆形建筑，四周人群聚集。建筑有暖赤陶色的低锥形屋顶，一道狭窄白光从顶点垂直升入近黑色上部色域。屋顶下，连续的小深色拱洞环绕上层。下方奶油色墙体有宽而浅的拱形分段；中央小门在带装饰的半圆楣下张开为黑色矩形。更高的棕色石建筑紧贴两侧，层叠窗户和深开口使圆形主体显得更亮、更独立。身披长袍的人群聚在建筑左右两侧。左边，人群从画边弯向建筑，深棕衣物之间夹杂几件浅色斗篷。右边另一组人在建筑与邻近高楼之间站得紧密。前方有少数人物彼此分开，留下通往中央入口的浅色开放前场。他们的小面孔和衣服细节受控而简化，没有单个人物占据主导。暖土色颜料、灰棕石色与灰奶油色建立建筑群，上部天空则是一大片炭黑色域。奇异白光提供最强的明度反差，较柔和的环境光照亮正面墙和地面，没有明显硬投影。哑光表面有细颗粒和轻微磨损的湿壁画般质感。整体构图庄严且高度居中，用对称建筑团块与聚集的人群节奏把注意力汇向发光屋顶。
style_prompt_en: The matte painting uses warm earth pigments, aged cream, gray-brown, and concentrated charcoal within a carefully centered arrangement. Forms are simplified into solid geometric masses, repeated small apertures, and broad shallow curves, with fine linear detail reserved for selected edges. Soft surface grain and worn pigment give the color fields an old fresco or tempera character. Dark groups collect along both sides of a larger pale central volume, while an open lower passage guides attention inward. A narrow vertical beam or pale accent creates the highest contrast against an expansive dark upper field. Ambient light remains subdued and even, with little cast shadow; value separation carries the structure more than glossy highlights. Repeated upright small shapes form rhythmic clusters around the central geometry. The overall effect is solemn, ordered, and symbolic, with spatial depth kept shallow enough for the image to read as a unified painted plane.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅哑光绘画在精心居中的安排中使用暖土色颜料、陈旧奶油色、灰棕与集中的炭黑。形体简化为结实几何团块、重复小开口和宽阔浅曲线，纤细线性细节只留在选定边缘。柔和表面颗粒和磨损颜料赋予色域旧湿壁画或蛋彩的性格。深色群块聚在较大浅色中央体量两侧，下部开放通道则引导注意力向内。一道狭窄竖向亮色重音在宽阔深色上部区域前形成最高反差。环境光低调且均匀，几乎没有投影；结构主要由明度分离承担，而非光亮高光。重复的直立小形体围绕中央几何形成有节奏的群簇。整体效果庄严、有秩序且富于象征意味，空间深度保持较浅，使图像仍读作统一绘画平面。
theme_en: A crowd gathered around a round pale building beneath a narrow beam of light
theme_zh: 人群聚在一道窄光下的浅色圆形建筑周围
name: Giotto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
